=== start-server ===
#!/bin/bash

# Start server
if [ "$1" = "-r" ]; then
    echo "Starting Development server with reload."
    exec uvicorn main:app --reload
else
    echo "Starting Production server."
    exec gunicorn -w 1 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker main:app --bind=0.0.0.0
fi

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/compose/dev && cat scenarios/all.yml 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== start-server ==="; cat /workspace/apps/data_store_backend/scripts/start-server.sh
